questions.question: What did Job long to do?
options: Find God and present his case before him
Forget God and all his ways
Flee far away from the very presence of God
Die quickly and end his suffering
questions.answer: Find God and present his case before him

questions.question: What did Job say would happen when God tested him?
options: He would come out as gold
questions.answer: He would come out as gold
